source.title: Profession tool swapping depending on the craft - Question on Min/Maxing

quote: This change of tools and use of phial brings resourcefulness from 4% to 20%.
notes: New original February 2025 TWW JC process-control lead (not previously indexed in the repo's code search): author reports R5 blue profession gear, +329 Resourcefulness tool, R3 Phial of Bountiful Seasons +135, and displayed Resourcefulness changing from 4% to 20% while prospecting. This is an individual setup claim, not an observed yield experiment; no purchased ore input counts, resource refunds, actual completed casts, gem output IDs/quantities, castsWithDrop or per-cast histogram. It cannot fill T0007/T0008/T0009/T0040 numeric baselines, and is not a post-2024-10-25 measured output cohort. Distinguish displayed Resourcefulness stat from reprocessed ore and observed total casts. Previous Apr2025 8%-relative-gem post (reddit 1k78h4v) already indexed in migration residuals and is not added again.
lookingFor: Independent rank-and-build-resolved post-2024-10-25 Ironclaw/Bismuth/Aqirite prospecting observations that report actual completed 5-ore operations separately from purchased inputs and Resourcefulness refunds, and per-output item IDs, hit/zero counts and positive-stack histograms
